meeting_scene: The team settled in around the conference table, their faces a mix of fatigue and focus as they waited for Sam to break the silence. He cleared his throat and began, "I think we've all been feeling pretty overwhelmed lately with that upcoming project deadline looming over us." Priya nodded thoughtfully from across the room, her eyes locked intently on Alex, who was scribbling some notes in their lappad without any visible content - an old habit of theirs when they needed to focus. Jordan shifted uncomfortably under his chair, rubbing at a knot in his shoulder where stress had been weighing heavy for him all week; Riya and Vikram exchanged sympathetic glances from opposite ends of the table.
